question: Please list the name of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T1.name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.convertedManaCost DESC) AS __r FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap') AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' ORDER BY T1.convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: List the names of all cards in the set named Coldsnap whose converted mana cost equals the highest converted mana cost among cards in that set, including every card tied for the highest value
b.sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap') AND convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap'))

d.request: What are the names of all cards in the Coldsnap set with the highest converted mana cost, including every card tied for that maximum?
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM cards AS c JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost) FROM cards AS c2 JOIN sets AS s2 ON c2.setCode = s2.code WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap')
